text: The 'Additional 1 Trillion Yuan Central Government Bonds for Disaster Relief and Flood Prevention (2023–2024)' is a fiscal initiative by China aimed at rebuilding disaster-hit areas and enhancing the country's disaster-prevention, flood-control, and emergency management systems. The initiative involves the issuance of special treasury bonds to finance approximately 15,000 public projects across eight priority areas, including major river flood-control works, reservoir upgrades, urban drainage, and irrigation rehabilitation. The program is designed to address critical resilience gaps revealed by the 2023 floods and support domestic demand amid constrained local government finances.
